scope: Eight selected AI descriptor name literals, with actual condition and target-selector bank boundaries and indexed code consumers. No blanket AI program/data/callback-code equivalence.

sources.policy: Static data and ordinary Steam.shared code only; no protector.arch decoding or game/emulator execution.

condition.legacy_mapping: all old entries retain index/name/metadata/callback-nullness; code-address equality or whole callback equivalence is not claimed

target_selector.legacy_mapping: all old entries retain index/name/metadata/callback-nullness; code-address equality or whole callback equivalence is not claimed

reader_correspondence.ps2_condition: btlAICommandPickTableAction001de800, btlAICommand.c:1767-1815: two*three conditions, kind0=false else D609850[kind*3](action,low24). Also actual script/effect wrappers use same root.
reader_correspondence.ps2_target: btlTargetAIPickAction001eb1d0, btlTarget.c:94-111: actual AI state/selected weighted command, D609ce0[topbyte*2](action,low24), false->entry0(action,0).

nso_core.actual_condition_load: 1cc10 establishes70a0c8; repeated actual top-byte*24 callback loads for both condition rows;0 skipped
nso_core.actual_target_load: 1d068 materializes709e48; packed selected target word indexes16-byte callback records at decomp lines204-206
nso_core.upstream_ai_record: realaction.unit+38,charIdu16+a4, recordbase through8805d0, stridea4; payload supplier not qualified here

reader_correspondence.steam_condition_detail: 6974d topbyte;69750 zero test;6975f low24 mask;69765 index*3;6976b LEAaf97b0;6977f JMP[base+index*8], effective24-byte stride.
reader_correspondence.steam_target_detail: 697ad LEAaf9f60;697b4 topbyte;697b8 low24;697be index*2;697c6 CALL[base+index*8], effective16-byte stride; false697d3 retries callback0(action,0).

ENBAD_ALL.structure: Walk real action list; require active flags1/8, opposing genus, not dead via7a7d0, requested status via72450. Return false on first living opponent failing mask, true when none fail. This independently distinguishes condition boolean role from a target mutation.

HANSYA_ST.structure: Actual candidate builder, down-status exclusion100000, reflectbit25, real candidate/random choice and target handles/count mutation; special candidate path preserved.

negative_evidence.finding: 6098bc is condition callback slot9, not the bank base. A guessed flag-first record order misleadingly produced69/73 trailing rows and apparent missing references. Actual callback/name/metadata order and reader root609850/70a0c8 recover78/82 including NULL0.

609df0 is an interior target callback slot34, not a separate root. Actual target bank609ce0 has40 entries. Following NSO70a0c8 NULL triple is the next CONDITION bank, not target entry40; callback/name pairs alone cannot merge the adjacent banks.

Condition and target banks reverse relative order across the Golden images: Steam condition precedes target; NSO target precedes condition. No relative-image-gap, raw pointer-number or label-only module inference is used.

required_seams.owner: Golden AI descriptor name supplier and namespace
required_seams.requirement: Route five condition names by opcode14/54/66/70/76 in the82-record Golden condition bank, and three target-selector names by opcode21/23/37 in its separate40-record bank. Author exact qualified Golden NUL-terminated strings; preserve only listed zero alignment tails. Names are actual callback-record fields, not free-floating cosmetic strings or the same-named function in another namespace. Cover actual direct/translated/inlined/native descriptor/name routes and mode isolation, without writing platform code/host pointer values into guest tables.

required_seams.owner: condition interpreter live AI record and packed operand producer
required_seams.requirement: Actual core1cbe0 gets current action.unit through+38 and realu16 charId+ a4, then actual AI-record storage via8805d0, stridea4. Two rows of three packedu32 conditions at record+4/8/c and18/1c/20 feed opcode=word>>24 and argument=word&ffffff;0 yields false and MUST NOT call NULL record0. Dispatch remaining opcode through82*24 bank70a0c8, callback+0. Preserve real AI-record/selector bytes (8 is skip sentinel), actual action/unit/data handles and script/native packed input, not fabricated IDs or zero operands. This proof does not qualify the AI-record payload bank; its actual Golden producer must be separately bound.

required_seams.owner: target selection live formation, state and result publication
required_seams.requirement: Actual selected weighted-command target word supplies top-byte target opcode and low24-bit argument to40*16 bank709e48; actual command work is populated before selection. Target procedures mutate actual action target handles/count, not merely return a predicate boolean. Representative HANSYA_ST2e530 uses real candidate builder661a0, candidate array+100/count168, unit/action state, status100000 exclusion via72450 and element-reflect bit25 via771d0; actual RNG715a0 picks eligible candidates and publishes chosen handle+48/count+aa, or clears through1c680. Preserve expanded/special candidate path, selection side effects and downstream command readers. Ordinary Steam69790 retries descriptor0 with argument0 on false; core1cbe0 has its own Golden candidate/RNG fallback, which must not be replaced with that generic fallback.
